title: No player locator bar
description: Deletes the player locator bar, so no one can see where are you
body:
**IF USING SPIGOT OR PAPER, TYPE /activateNPLB IN YOUR WORLD TO ACTIVATE PLUGIN!**

**No Player Locator Bar** is a functional utility mod designed to improve the Minecraft user interface by removing the player locator bar. In modern versions of the game. The HUD often features markers or bars that pinpoint the player's exact orientation and location. This mod disables that specific HUD element, so no one can see where are you.

**Why use this mod?**

Modern Minecraft UI can sometimes feel overly informative, providing guides that simplify the survival experience. This mod is specifically tailored for:

**Hardcore & Realism Enthusiasts:** If you prefer a gameplay style where the game doesn't show too much information, removing the locator bar is an essential step toward a true survival challenge.

**Modpack Creators:** An ideal addition for Expert or Realism themed modpacks where map navigation is intended to be a learned skill.

**Cinematic Gameplay:** Great for players who record gameplay or take screenshots and want to reduce the amount of artificial UI overlays on the screen.

**Compatibility and Installation**

- Version Support: Compatible with major mod loaders (Fabric/Quilt/NeoForge) depending on the selected build.

- Mod Compatibility: Works alongside other UI-altering mods. It strictly targets the player locator component and should not interfere with mini-map mods or inventory tweaks.

- Lightweight Design: No external dependencies required. Simply drop the file into your mods folder and launch the game. (Use fabric API if playing on fabric)
